The bowl is about 15 cm across in the image (roughly 255 px, from x=288 to 545). The food patch is about 175 px wide, so roughly 10 cm, and it sits as a small mound.

The food looks like cottage cheese or rice pudding, possibly a milk-based porridge. I'll treat it as a mound about 10 cm wide and 3 cm high. That is a spherical-cap volume of about (π·h/6)(3r² + h²) = (3.14·3/6)(75 + 9) ≈ 132 mL, so about 130 g.

If it is cottage cheese at about 100 kcal per 100 g, that gives roughly 130 kcal. Rice pudding would be about 130 kcal per 100 g, or roughly 170 kcal. I'll settle on about 150 g and 160 kcal.

{"kcal": 160, "mass_g": 150}
